Class PersonStyle

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.curriculum.PersonStyle
public final class PersonStyle extends Object
How one real opponent fights, as counted in /swordai fight from what the user's own game could see, summed over every fight against that player; and the scripted opponent made from it, which training then fights (StageSpec.peopleShare). Not a recording of the fights: a recording does not answer what the fighter does differently, so what is kept is the habits, and the script plays them out against whatever the fighter does.

Saved as swordai/people/<name>.json: a few hundred bytes a player.
